title: Estimate-Stage Charges: Posting Rules of Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
**General.** Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate-stage charges post to the booking as follows, each once per booking. A charge posts only while the booking is in checked-in, estimate-written, cancelled, no-show, declined or expired status, as the booking record shows. An estimate type whose fee is zero posts nothing for that fee type. Charges post the same way on insurance-claim and customer-pay bookings; who settles them is set by the settlement rules for charges.

| Charge | Posts when | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-repair scan | On the estimate written date, where the estimate type includes a pre-repair scan | The estimate type's pre-repair diagnostic scan fee |
| Tow-in | On the check-in date, where the estimate type offers a network-arranged tow-in and the vehicle arrived on a network-arranged tow | The tow hook-up charge plus the rate per tow mile for every tow mile beyond the free radius |
| Mobile trip | On a customer-pay Mobile Estimate that was cancelled late or missed | The mobile trip fee |

**Retired clauses.** The following former clauses are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis for that charge:

- "A teardown charge of the estimate type's teardown fee posts on the estimate written date where the estimate type includes a teardown" — no longer in force, superseded by the current teardown charge basis.
- "A measurement charge of the estimate type's measurement fee posts on the estimate written date where the estimate type produces a measurement report" — no longer in force, superseded by the current measurement charge basis.

**Tow-in worked figures** (hypothetical tow distances; tariff figures as scheduled for the two types that arrange a tow):

- A 40-mile tow on a Blueprint Teardown Estimate (25-mile free radius, 4.25 USD a mile, 95.00 USD hook-up): 15 miles beyond the radius multiplied by 4.25 USD is 63.75 USD; the charge is 95.00 USD plus 63.75 USD, 158.75 USD.
- A 20-mile tow on the same type: no mile lies beyond the radius; the charge is the 95.00 USD hook-up alone.
- A 40-mile tow on a Structural Blueprint Estimate (35-mile free radius): 5 miles multiplied by 4.25 USD is 21.25 USD; the charge is 116.25 USD.

superseded_clauses: A teardown charge of teardown_fee_usd posts on the estimate written date where teardown_included is true
a measurement charge of measurement_fee_usd posts on the estimate written date where measurement_report_included is true
